scoring: Score observed controller transitions and executed tools separately from provider labels. A retained ambiguous request with clarification is a safe abstention, not a successful intended transition. Incorrect activation, closure or unsupported factual use is a failure. Provider errors/oversize refusals are incomplete, never passes. Review prose claims against frozen sources; substring checks are diagnostic only. No prompt tuning after dispatch.

relatedNotes.title: Thermostat control
relatedNotes.text: A thermostat switches heating according to its sensor measurement and control settings. Record the displayed target and the actual sensor reading before explaining a difference.

relatedNotes.title: Probe measurement method
relatedNotes.text: Keep the temperature probe 18 cm from the fan. Preserve individual readings and units before calculating an average.

relatedNotes.title: Vial identification
relatedNotes.text: A clear label or coloured band can help distinguish sample vials. A proposed labelling change needs testing.

relatedNotes.title: Fern watering observations
relatedNotes.text: Fern leaf curling can accompany dry soil. Compare observations before and after watering without treating one observation as proof of a sole cause.

relatedNotes.title: Dispenser calibration
relatedNotes.text: An uncalibrated dispenser introduces uncertainty in liquid volume readings. A reported reading does not establish an intended target volume.

relatedNotes.title: Travel reminder
relatedNotes.text: Bring a rail ticket and a raincoat for the journey.
